evidenceClasses.proves: The selected source parses, types, lints, or satisfies a static contract.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: The program ran or the user workflow completed.

evidenceClasses.proves: The selected unit or component produced the asserted result under controlled inputs.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: Packaging, external providers, end-to-end integration, deployment, or another profile.

evidenceClasses.proves: The protocol, orchestration, or error path handled a deterministic model double as asserted.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: Genuine model inference, provider availability, soak, resilience, release, or production readiness.

evidenceClasses.proves: A named workflow traversed the supported packaged UAR boundary and returned the observed result.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: A model boundary unless genuine loaded-model evidence is also retained, or any untested workflow/profile.

evidenceClasses.proves: The named provider/model performed genuine inference through UAR for the bounded functional path.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: Broad model quality, every provider, long-duration resilience, deployment, or another profile.

evidenceClasses.proves: The specified workload exercised its named failure model, volume, operating period, or statistical objective.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: Inference when traffic uses a model double, or production readiness beyond the stated workload and environment.

evidenceClasses.proves: The deployed artifact became reachable and satisfied the named deployment checks.
evidenceClasses.doesNotProve: Routine unit/integration correctness, model inference, or undeployed profiles.
